text: もりは　みちと　なにが　ちがうの？

patterns.name: 〜と (comparing)
patterns.explanation: と with ちがう names the thing something is different from. みちと ちがう = 'different from roads'.

patterns.name: 〜の (question)
patterns.explanation: の at the end of a casual sentence makes it a soft question asking for an explanation. なにが ちがうの？ = 'what is different?'.
